reward_function_interface: def compute_reward(state, m_power, s_power, terminated) -> (float, dict)
primary_objective: Land the spacecraft on the landing pad at (0,0) with zero velocity, upright orientation, and minimal fuel consumption, as fast as possible.
state_space_summary: 8-dimensional vector: [x, y, vx, vy, angle, angular_velocity, leg1_contact, leg2_contact] normalized to approximately [-1,1].
action_space_summary: Discrete: 0 (do nothing), 1 (fire left orientation engine), 2 (fire main engine), 3 (fire right orientation engine).

action_semantics.0: No engine thrust; coast or free-fall.
action_semantics.1: Fire left orientation engine: applies torque to rotate lander clockwise (rightward tilt) and a small lateral impulse.
action_semantics.2: Fire main engine: applies upward thrust (opposite to lander's tip direction) to slow descent or ascend.
action_semantics.3: Fire right orientation engine: applies torque to rotate lander counterclockwise (leftward tilt) and a small lateral impulse.

state_semantics.0: Normalized horizontal position (x): -1 (left edge) to +1 (right edge), 0 at pad.
state_semantics.1: Normalized vertical position (y): -1 (ground) to +1 (top), 0 at pad height.
state_semantics.6: Left leg ground contact: 1 if touching ground, else 0.
state_semantics.7: Right leg ground contact: 1 if touching ground, else 0.

intended_behavior_phases: Phase 1: Descent and stabilization - reduce vertical speed, center horizontally over pad, maintain upright orientation.
Phase 2: Final approach - fine-tune position and velocity to land softly on pad with both legs contacting simultaneously.
Phase 3: Landing - zero velocity, upright, both legs on ground, terminate with success.

required_action_by_phase.Phase 1: Main engine (action 2) to slow descent; orientation engines (actions 1,3) to correct tilt and drift.
required_action_by_phase.Phase 2: Main engine (action 2) for soft landing; orientation engines (actions 1,3) for precise alignment.
required_action_by_phase.Phase 3: No action (action 0) or minimal main engine if needed; avoid any action that destabilizes.

necessary_behaviors: Fire main engine to counteract gravity and control descent rate.
Use orientation engines to keep the lander upright (angle near 0) and correct horizontal drift.
Achieve near-zero velocity (vx, vy) and upright angle at touchdown.
Land on the pad (x near 0, y near 0) with both legs contacting ground.
success_signals_available_to_reward: Both legs ground contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Episode termination without crash or out-of-bounds.
dangerous_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely at safe altitude without landing (avoids crash but never succeeds).
Landing with high vertical speed (crash) but receiving small negative reward if not penalized enough.
Using orientation engines excessively causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing outside pad but with low speed (no crash, but not success).
primary_selection_metric: Episodic return (cumulative reward) averaged over many episodes.
proxy_metrics: Distance to pad at end of episode.
Vertical speed at first ground contact.
Fuel consumption (total main engine power used).
diagnostic_metrics: Success rate (landing on pad with both legs, low speed, upright).
Average horizontal and vertical speed at touchdown.
Average fuel used per successful landing.
reward_design_constraints: Reward must be a scalar float returned by compute_reward.
Must encourage landing on pad with low speed and upright orientation.
Should penalize crashes and out-of-bounds strongly.
Should provide shaping (e.g., distance-based, velocity-based) to guide learning.
Fuel penalty should be mild to avoid discouraging necessary engine use.
Avoid reward components that conflict (e.g., penalizing angle while requiring orientation engine use).
Ensure reward is bounded and stable for training.
